key_takeaway: IEEE118 early-stop ordered N-2 protocol fixes the formal valid-path universe.
Original Algorithm 1 was completed, but current single-scenario/pilot performance is weak.
12-state smoke proves the S0/S1 paper-aligned data/training/eval chain runs.
Pilot-2000 is the closest current IEEE118 result to paper-aligned RTS-79 training, but is not paper-8000.
Many critical paths are low-p_first / high-p_second, explaining why strict path_prob is suppressed.
Alpha path probability shows reducing the hard p_first gate improves low-budget ranking.
Any-critical first-line fragility is all-positive and cannot be a discriminative classifier.
Strict top-q fragility targets fix label degeneracy and slightly improve some low-budget comparisons.
